# Research Workflow

```text
/grill-me -> /spectrum-matrix -> /council -> /prompt-forge -> /deep-research -> /tts-optimize -> Speechify
```

## Workflow Steps

| Step | Command                     | Purpose                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ---- | --------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1    | `/grill-me`                 | Get your thoughts together, reduce cardinality, and avoid wasting tokens. The linked prompt is not mine, and it is only a few lines long, but it is better than it has any right to be.                                                                                                                                                                     |
| 2    | `/spectrum-matrix`          | Run a three-agent, multi-round idea tournament with a skeptical Adversary, a neutral Pragmatist, and an optimistic Advocate. Use this when someone is weighing, or is about to commit to, a consequential choice that would benefit from being challenged from every angle. It gives ideas a weighted score based on critic, pragmatist, and optimist wins. |
| 3    | `/council`                  | Swarm on the best approach for getting the most out of the research task, targeting the best ideas that align with the actual reason you want to do the research.                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| 4    | `/prompt-forge`             | Take the refined ideas and strengthen the prompt across eight dimensions, including clarity, sufficient context, and clear intent. Then hand the result to the research agent.                                                                                                                                                                              |
| 5    | `/deep-research`            | Use the verbatim prompt from `/prompt-forge`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| 6    | `/tts-optimize` + Speechify | Optional. Iterate over the returned research, parse tables into semantic meaning, and smooth out anything the TTS engine might pronounce awkwardly, including characters, URLs, and punctuation. The goal is a TED Talk-style podcast, lecture, or plain-text document that tells a cohesive story for more than an hour.                                   |

## Speechify

Speechify has some of the most believable voices, tones, and accents. You can take the TTS-optimized plain-text speech and turn it into an MP3 to play in the car, creating customized learning on any subject, at whatever depth and tone you want.
